\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgf,pgffor}
\begin{document}
% A cross product exercises termination, decimal carries, tiny divisors,
% signed quotients and large values without depending on the JS evaluator.
\foreach \a in {0.00002,0.00003,0.0001,0.17,0.99999,1.2345,7.49999,12.345}{%
  \foreach \b in {0.001,0.1,0.3,0.7,1.00002,1.1,1.2345,1.5,2.5,6.789,100.1,101.25,9999.5}{%
    \pgfmathparse{\a/\b}\typeout{GRIDPROBE:\a/\b;\pgfmathresult}%
    \pgfmathparse{-\a/\b}\typeout{GRIDPROBE:-\a/\b;\pgfmathresult}%
  }%
}
\end{document}
